tei:div.tei:p: )rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye ba'i smon lam rig 'dzin mchog gi bde lam ni/ e ma ho/ kun khyab brdal ba chen po chos kyi dbyings// tshad med ye shes snang ba 'byams klas pa'i// zung 'jug rdo rje rol mo'i sprin bkod pa// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog /'di nas lho nub rnga yab srin po'i gling*// 'jigs rung grong khyer du mas bskor ba'i dbus// pad+ma rā ga'i ri dbang lhun mtho brjid// zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor= /rtse mo yangs shing rgya che khod snyoms par// rang byung rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i// ngo mtshar dpal gyi gzhal med khang chen mdzes// zangs mdog dpal gyi= /zur bzhi logs brgyad rab mdzes lcogs dang bcas// nor bu chu shel dang ni be ḍūr+ya// pad rag in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs 'od 'tsher// zangs mdog= /sum thog kha bad mthong skar yangs pa'i sgo// rta babs bzhi ldan chos 'khor gdugs ri dwags// bye ru'i sgo glegs gzi mchong sgo gtan spras// zangs mdog= /dbus phyur mar gad rā ga pha lam sogs// rgya phib sum brtsegs mda' yab pu shus brgyan// kun snang nor bu'i 'phrul tog lham mer gsal// zangs mdog= /sna tshogs rin chen drwa phyed 'phyang 'phrul bres// zla phyed rdo rje dar dpyangs rnga yab g.yo// rang byung chos kyi sgra ldan dril g.yer 'khrol// zangs mdog= /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam nor bu'i sprin// kun nas yongs gtibs bar snang sprin gseb tu// yid 'ong lha yi bu dang bu mos gang*// zangs mdog= /kun kyang gdugs bzang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs// snyan sgrogs rol mo'i sgra dang bstod dbyangs bcas// dri med shel bum spos chu'i khrus chab sbrengs// zangs mdog= /phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od zer phreng 'khrigs pa'i gur// rab mdzes me tog char zim lding khang 'khyil// bde rlung dri bzang spos ngad kun tu 'thul// zangs mdog=

/'dod yon snam bur mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// sgeg bzhad glu gar rnam 'gyur mtha' yas pas// rab 'byams mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod du spro// zangs mdog= /rang snang zhing gzhan kun tu bsti ba yi// sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// zhing der nyi zer rdul 'khrigs lta bur gtibs// zangs mdog= /mtha' skor phyi nas rim bzhin thod pa dang*// lcags zangs dngul gser 'od lnga'i ra ba ste// khor sa rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor// zangs mdog= /nang nas rim bzhin khrus rdzing ngang pas brgyan// me tog do rar ri dwags bag phebs rtse// sman gyi spangs ljongs bdud rtsi'i chu klung 'bebs// zangs mdog= /nor bu'i gram thang gser gyi bye mas khengs// rin chen ljon shing lo 'dab 'bras bu dud// sprul pa'i bya tshogs snyan pa'i chos sgra sgrogs// zangs mdog= /khor sa tha mar rak+ta'i zham chu 'babs// zhing chen lhu dum 'khrugs pa'i rba rlabs 'phyo// gtum rngam bya gcan sna tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs// zangs mdog= /phyi rol mun 'obs srin po'i sgo srung tshogs// rngams pa'i gad rgyang 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha thogs// skal med tshogs rnams rgyu ba'i go skabs bral// zangs mdog= /yon tan lhun grub pho brang dbus kyi char// rin chen seng khri 'dab stong ge sar la// thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od du brdal// zangs mdog= /de na bdag gi 'dren pa ngo mtshar can// skyabs gnas kun 'dus sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// snang srid zil gnon pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs// zangs mdog= /brtul zhugs spyod 'chang 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dgyes 'dzum ye re ba// brtse ba'i spyan zlum lta stangs hrig ger gzigs// zangs mdog= /brjod bral 'gag med gsung mchog tshangs pa'i dbyangs// yan lag drug cu rdzogs pa seng ge'i sgra// zab yangs bdud rtsi'i chos sgra lhangs se lhang*// zangs mdog=

/rnam par mi rtog spros pa bral ba'i thugs// zab gsal gnyis med ye shes snying po can// mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro kun bu ltar skyong*// zangs mdog= /gtso bo'i mtha' skor nyi dang zer bzhin du// thod phreng sde lnga mtshan mchog brgyad la sogs// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul bkod pa cir yang ston// zangs mdog= /mdun gral g.yas su rgya bod rig 'dzin tshogs// klong yangs bya rtsol bral ba'i dgongs dbyings su// rdo rje'i mgur glu sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs spyod// zangs mdog= /mdun gral g.yon du mchog gzigs lo paṇa rnams// zab don bsgro gleng bsgyur bshad 'chad nyan gyi// so so'i gsung gdangs ma 'dres lhang nger gsal// zangs mdog= /g.yas gral g.yas su gter 'byin grub pa'i khyu// dgongs brgyud don ston shog ser tshig brgyud gyi// brda 'grol ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi zlos gar bsgyur// zangs mdog= /g.yas gral g.yon du rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs// dmod pa'i g.yul 'gyed las kyi mde'u kha bsgyur// 'gal byed bdud dgra 'byung po phye mar 'thag /zangs mdog= /g.yon gral g.yas su rgya bal ḍā ki'i tshogs// bde ba'i nyams rgyas lang tsho'i bcud kyis gang*// gsang mchog bde ba chen po'i 'dod yon stob// zangs mdog= /g.yon gral g.yon du mon bod dha ki'i tshogs// rnal 'byor ma dpal rdo rje'i zlos gar gyi// bde stong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du bar spyod// zangs mdog= /gtso mchog mdun du dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal lcam// gus pa'i nyams rdzogs bde chen mchod sprin spro// skal ldan rjes 'dzin dbang bzhi'i brda chos ston// zangs mdog= /rgyab phyogs 'od lnga'i drwa ba 'khrigs pa'i nang*// theg mchog snying po'i klong sgrom glegs bam brtsegs// mdo rgyud man ngag chos kyi rang sgra ldir// zangs mdog= /khyam la dpal gyi pho nya ging ka ra// lang ka 'bar ma phra men gnas nyul rnams// nyams pa skrod cing dam ldan bu ltar skyong*// zangs mdog=

/sgo bzhir rgyal chen sde bzhi bka' sdod bcas// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpung khrom du 'tshogs// bar chad srung dang mchod pa'i sprin phung spro// zangs mdog= /phyi rol sprul pa'i srin rgyal chen po brgyad// legs nyes shan 'byed khrims kyi brda thabs kyis// sha za srin po'i tshogs rnams chos la btsud// zangs mdog= /bar khang 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i gur khyim du// snying rje'i dbang phyug longs sku pad+ma'i spyan// rab 'byams rtsa gsum zhing rdul 'khor du gtibs// zangs mdog= /steng khang stong gsal ye shes zhing gi dbus// gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od mi 'gyur// rang rtsal rol pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor// zangs mdog= sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus pa'i// yon tan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal// gcig tu 'khyil ba ngo mtshar sprul pa'i zhing*// zangs mdog= bdag ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe// gnad gcod sdug bsngal phung po'i zug rngu bral// bar do'i 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag mi mthong bar// tshad med bde dga' spro bas 'pho bar shog /'ja' 'od dar lam me tog sil ma'i char// 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra// 'dod yon mchod pa'i bye brag rab thogs pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsu shog /a ma mtsho rgyal mthing 'od 'bar ma yis// bu gcig dpal gyi ri bor da 'gro zhes// mngon sum lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste// pad+ma 'od kyi zhing der 'khrid par shog /der yang 'jigs pa'i sgo srung 'phrang sogs la// the tshom med par dpa' ba'i gding shugs kyis// skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur rab bgrod nas// pha cig gu ru'i zhal mchog mthong bar shog /sems kyi rin chen nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter// gang 'dod kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rdzas// zhing khams rgyas par 'gengs pa'i sprin spros te// lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mthu thob shog

/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral lhan cig tu// theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dga' ston longs spyod nas// dka' ba med par rig 'dzin sa bgrod de// pad+ma'i dgongs klong yangs par byang chub shog /de las gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar// rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams thabs du mas// mkha' mthas gtug pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// rnga yab dpal ri'i grong der 'dren par shog /bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg skye 'gro kun// dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma ka ra yis// thun min gdul byar brtse bas rjes bzung ste// smin cing grol ba'i skal bzang myur thob shog /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang*// chos can chos nyid bden pa mi bslu bas// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam 'di// gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa'ang tshe rabs kun tu mtsho skyes pad+ma dgyes pa'i bka' 'bangs su gyur pa'i skal pa bzang po can rig pa 'dzin pa'i myu gu 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes dbo nya ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus kyi mchod pa'i thog mos pa'i mthong snang phyogs gcig gi rjes su 'brang nas 'dod don smon pa'i tshig tu spel bar byas pa ste/ 'dis kyang 'brel bcas 'gro kun pad+ma 'od kyi grong du dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rgyur gyur cig //
